title: Bound on state-vector coordinates
statement: Let $B$ be a natural number and let $st$ be an exponential breadth-first search state whose 17 counters are each at most $B$. Then every coordinate of the state’s 17-entry counter vector is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Every one of the 17 counters of $st$ is at most $B$
The coordinate index ranges over the 17-entry vector
replaced:
Let $B$ be a natural number and let a state consist of the 17 natural-number counters
$N,Lg,s,s1,X,w,K,Bs,U,V,T,T2,Z,C,ch,c,c1$. If each of these counters is at most $B$,
then every coordinate of the state vector, whose entries are these counters in the
listed order, is at most $B$.
